verdict: Paid Instagram delivered $32.5K in sales on $6.5K spend — a 5x return. Keep running, but fix lead costs.
diagnosis: Return on ad spend sits near 5x this period, well above the food category median of 1.6x, but cost per lead is climbing.

signals.headline: Ad sales hit $32,494 this period
signals.detail: 673 purchases from $6,490 in spend means every ad dollar returned about $5 — strong for a food brand.

signals.headline: 673 purchases, 271 checkouts started
signals.detail: More purchases than checkout starts suggests tracking gaps or returning buyers skipping steps. Worth auditing the pixel setup.

signals.headline: 728 add-to-carts, 174 pixel purchases
signals.detail: Roughly 1 in 4 carts convert through the pixel. Cart abandonment is the biggest leak in the funnel right now.

signals.headline: Instagram following grew by 1,900
signals.detail: Organic reach is working. 13,368 total followers and 679 post engagements show the content is landing with the right audience.

signals.headline: 275 Google reviews added, 5-star average
signals.detail: Local reputation is a real asset. Reviews are converting local searches like "wildfork near me" into traffic.

benchmark.label: BENCHMARK
benchmark.subheader: Food brands average 1.6x return on ad spend
benchmark.body: <cite index="10-9,10-10">Food and beverage Meta campaigns run a $38.57 median cost per purchase at 1.89% conversion with 1.61x return on ad spend.</cite> Billy Doe's 5x return is roughly triple the category median.

seasonal.label: SEASONAL
seasonal.subheader: Ad prices rise sharply into Black Friday
seasonal.body: <cite index="15-10">Meta ad prices can climb up to 85% around Black Friday.</cite> Expect cost per purchase to rise through November. Lock in budget now while rates are still favorable.

competitor.label: COMPETITOR
competitor.subheader: Food cost per thousand impressions stays low
competitor.body: <cite index="16-10">Food and beverage maintains the lowest cost per thousand impressions at $8.14 on Meta.</cite> Billy Doe should be able to scale reach cheaply versus competitors in higher-cost categories.

recommendations.title: Scale the Premium Box campaign while returns hold
recommendations.detail: The current campaign returned 5x. Consider raising daily budget 20-30% and watching cost per purchase. Pull back if it crosses $45.

recommendations.title: Test an abandoned cart email or retargeting flow
recommendations.detail: 728 add-to-carts versus 174 pixel purchases shows real drop-off. A simple cart recovery sequence could capture lost revenue cheaply.

recommendations.title: Audit pixel tracking before Black Friday
recommendations.detail: Purchases reported exceed checkouts started, suggesting a tracking gap. Clean data matters more as ad costs rise through Q4.
